claims.value: SILAC light / SILAC heavy channel -> condition map
claims.evidence: Table S1 column headers state the heavy/light condition per Exp (e.g. "Sec24A.(H).vs.Ctrl.(L) - Exp1"). Each Table S1 Exp was matched to a MaxQuant experiment by identical per-protein Razor+unique peptide counts against FrankMeta2_proteinGroups4.txt (100% identity for all 16, next best <=42%): S2C Exp1=16-225-02, Exp2=16-225-01; S2D Exp1=16-186-01, Exp2=16-186-02; S2E Exp1=16-187-02, Exp2=16-187-01; S3A Exp1=E-15-244-01, Exp2=E-15-244-04, Exp3=16-162-02, Exp4=16-162-01; S4A Exp1..6=16-151-01,16-151-02,16-224-01,16-224-02,16-226-02,16-226-01. Direction independently cross-checked from Intensity H/L in proteinGroups.txt: vesicle-vs-mock runs show COPII cargo (SEC22B, LMAN1, SURF4, ERGIC1, ...) 2-5 log2 units higher in the stated vesicle channel; Sec24A vs Sec24C runs show SEC22B/CNIH4 (Sec24A clients) vs STX5/BET1/ERGIC1 (Sec24C clients) in the stated channels; LIL895AAA runs show STX5/BET1/SCFD1/GOSR2 depleted in the stated mutant channel. 0 discrepancies. S2D Exp2 ratio header reads "(H/L) Sec24C.(H)" while its peptide headers read "Sec24C.(L)"; intensities confirm Sec24C = light in 16-186-02.

limitations: Orbitrap Elite rows carry 35 NCE (read from the raw method), not the not available the coordinator suggested, because the raw header states the value.
techsdrf is not installed; instrument, activation, MS2 analyzer, TopN and NCE were read from HTTP-range-read .raw headers only (no tolerance/PTM refinement from spectra).
Full text is not in PMC/Europe PMC; it was read from the publisher-hosted "Article plus Supplemental Information" PDF (mmc4.pdf).
The paper (and PRIDE) state MaxQuant 1.5.3.8 and deamidation (NQ) as a variable modification; the deposited mqpar/parameters/summary say 1.5.3.30 and no deamidation. The deposited search was used.
The paper and PRIDE say "Q-Exactive"; raw headers say Q Exactive HF for all 14 non-Elite runs. The paper says Elite "up to 30" MS/MS; the raw method is Top20 CID. Raw files were used.

PRIDE protocol says "2 gel pieces per sample"; each deposited raw file is one MaxQuant experiment with no fraction annotation, so each file is one injection (fraction 1). Whether the two gel pieces were combined before injection is not stated.
mqpar includes 4 additional runs (E-15-056_01/_02, Q35D185-16-188-01/_02) that are neither deposited nor in Table S1; not annotated.

HeLa cell line identity for each experiment is inferred from the paper describing all COPII proteomes as HeLa-derived; Table S1 does not repeat the cell line per tab. The search used a human-only FASTA.

characteristics[disease] uses the broader MONDO:0005153 cervical adenocarcinoma; Cellosaurus says NCIt C27677 HPV-related endocervical adenocarcinoma, whose closest MONDO term (MONDO:0000554) xrefs a different NCIt code (C127907).
characteristics[treatment] values are free text (no ontology term for in vitro coat-reconstitution conditions); parse_sdrf emits 5 warnings.
comment[cleavage agent details] records the digestion enzyme (Trypsin); the MaxQuant search used the rule Trypsin/P, recorded as a manifest claim only.
ms-proteomics is declared at v1.2.0 (upstream bigbio/sdrf-templates 7da1747 latest); the spec submodule pinned in this repo is older and lists only 1.1.0.
characteristics[cell type] = not available: Cellosaurus CVCL_0030 states no cell type.
